Owner operations

Open the neighborhood.

These controls are available only to the contract owner. Every change requires a wallet transaction.

1. Bind the game

Authorize the deployed game to use SeasonPot and DeedVault. Each bindGame is one-shot and permanent.

Checking bindings…

2. Start a season

Open joining and set the buy-in, length, minimum roll balance and maximum deed purchase. The previous season must be finalized.

List a property

Pair a token with IMD using its existing v4 pool. A correction needs all deeds and sponsorship obligations cleared.

Game parameters

Set the GO salary, roll cooldown and eight rent amounts between seasons. Existing claims and exits stay available.

Pause play

Pause new rolls or deed purchases. Reveals, withdrawals, redemptions and claims remain available.
